say:1:1131037101:0.text: I'll tell you a secret... Rhys is an awful singer, and he only knows one song!
say:1:1131037101:0.source_cn: 偷偷告诉你哦……诡草哥哥唱歌特别难听，而且只会唱一首！
say:1:1131037101:0.male: I'll tell you a secret... Rhys is an awful singer, and he only knows one song!
say:1:1131037101:0.female: I'll tell you a secret... Rhys is an awful singer, and he only knows one song!

say:2:1131037102:0.text: He used to hum the same song every time he fed the terrabirds, until one day... guess what happened!
say:2:1131037102:0.source_cn: 他去喂陆行鸟的时候，经常哼着那首歌。结果有一天……你猜...
say:2:1131037102:0.male: He used to hum the same song every time he fed the terrabirds, until one day... guess what happened!
say:2:1131037102:0.female: He used to hum the same song every time he fed the terrabirds, until one day... guess what happened!

choice_prompt:3:1131037102.text: He used to hum the same song every time he fed the terrabirds, until one day... guess what happened!
choice_prompt:3:1131037102.source_cn: 他去喂陆行鸟的时候，经常哼着那首歌。结果有一天……你猜，之后怎么了！
choice_prompt:3:1131037102.male: He used to hum the same song every time he fed the terrabirds, until one day... guess what happened!
choice_prompt:3:1131037102.female: He used to hum the same song every time he fed the terrabirds, until one day... guess what happened!

say:4:1131037103:0.text: Come on! Rhys sang so loud. We all heard him, but no one dared to laugh aloud.
say:4:1131037103:0.source_cn: 哎呀，诡草哥哥嗓门那么大，大家都能听见！只不过是不敢笑而已。
say:4:1131037103:0.male: Come on! Rhys sang so loud. We all heard him, but no one dared to laugh aloud.
say:4:1131037103:0.female: Come on! Rhys sang so loud. We all heard him, but no one dared to laugh aloud.

say:5:1131037104:0.text: Well, tell you what—one of the terrabirds learned the song!
say:5:1131037104:0.source_cn: 告诉你吧，是一只陆行鸟学会了！
say:5:1131037104:0.male: Well, tell you what—one of the terrabirds learned the song!
say:5:1131037104:0.female: Well, tell you what—one of the terrabirds learned the song!

say:7:1131037105:0.text: That's right! A terrabird learned to hum the tune.
say:7:1131037105:0.source_cn: 没错！居然有一只陆行鸟也学会了哼那首歌的调子。
say:7:1131037105:0.male: That's right! A terrabird learned to hum the tune.
say:7:1131037105:0.female: That's right! A terrabird learned to hum the tune.

say:8:1131037106:0.text: You couldn't really call it singing, but it sounded so much better than Rhys!
say:8:1131037106:0.source_cn: 虽然不是真的在“唱”，但，它叫的调子比诡草哥哥好听多了！
say:8:1131037106:0.male: You couldn't really call it singing, but it sounded so much better than Rhys!
say:8:1131037106:0.female: You couldn't really call it singing, but it sounded so much better than Rhys!

say:9:1131037107:0.text: When it made its first high-pitched call, Rhys was blue in the face!
say:9:1131037107:0.source_cn: 它第一次开口叫出高音的时候，诡草哥哥脸都绿了呢！
say:9:1131037107:0.male: When it made its first high-pitched call, Rhys was blue in the face!
say:9:1131037107:0.female: When it made its first high-pitched call, Rhys was blue in the face!
